I hunted for what that document could add beyond the 5B cash figures and the pre-released impairment: going-concern language, the MU-5 FID and subsequent events.
event_check: The event is real but its exact date is not confirmed. For a 30 June year-end the audited annual report must be lodged by 30 Sep 2026. On 24 Sep 2026 the company announced the impairment 'as part of the completion of its financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026', so the accounts are being finalised now. Last year's annual report landed 29/09/2025 at 5:13pm, the business day before the deadline. There is no forward notice of the date, and nothing has been lodged since 25/09/2026. The vendor's 28 Sep amc date fits the pattern, but lodging on 29 Sep amc or 30 Sep would fall outside this window. I put the chance it lands inside the window at roughly 50-60%. positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short is 1.494% as of 2026-09-21, 4 sessions stale, up 0.046pp from 1.448% on 2026-09-14. That is slow building from a low base, not a crowded short, so the lean's short_squeeze component (+0.90) looks overstated for this name. The more relevant positioning fact is a long-side seller. Davidson Kempner converted its loan into equity in April-June 2026, then sold on market 21-28 Aug at A$0.276-0.310, going from 37.5m shares (6.57%) to 28.1m (4.92%). It then crossed below the disclosure line. Run-up is -13.56% over 20 days and -8.93% over 5 days, which fits continued supply.

findings.finding: Davidson Kempner still held 28,137,293 PEN shares (4.92%) when it 'ceased to be a substantial holder' on 28 Aug 2026. After selling ~9.4m shares in six sessions it is below the disclosure line, so any further selling is invisible. The residual is about 17 sessions of median volume (~1.6m shares a day at A$0.255 on A$412k turnover).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: DK sold 21-28 Aug at A$0.276-0.310 and the stock went from 0.300 (24 Aug) to 0.255 (25 Sep), about -15%. There was no single-day break, only a steady drift lower. Earlier DK conversions (Feb, Apr, Jun 2026) were each followed by weakness, but I have not isolated those effects, so this is a pattern and not a measured reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline the market saw was 'Ceasing to be a substantial holder', which reads as 'exit complete'. The body shows a 4.92% residual that no longer has to be disclosed. If the market treated this as live supply, a 1.49% short with a tiny build would not be carrying a +0.90 squeeze component in the priced lean, and the stock would not have needed a further ~15% fall in September to find buyers. That said, part of that drift is probably this seller already being priced, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The same seller's earlier Form 604 (28 Aug, https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260828/pdf/073dmz1v0jptsj.pdf) shows the pace of 2.3-2.4m shares a day. It is the same holder and the same filing series, so it is not independent evidence. The tape (Yahoo PEN.AX: 20d run-up -13.56%, 5d -8.93%) is consistent but does not prove it.

outside_window.finding: The 22 Jul 2026 guidance update said the MU-5 final investment decision was 'expected in September 2026' (the body text, page 4). The 31 Jul quarterly moved that to 'before the end of CY2026'. With cash of about US$47m at 17 Jul against roughly US$18m of operating plus development burn a quarter, an MU-5 FID would likely come with a funding requirement. The most likely venue is the October quarterly or a standalone release, not this window. I sized it near zero and signed it negative because it probably arrives paired with a capital need.

September-quarter 5B, due by 31 Oct. Implied cash at 30 Sep is about US$29-30m: US$47.1m at 17 Jul less ~2.5 months at the June quarter's US$18.3m combined operating plus development burn. Revenue in CY26 is minimal because guidance was withdrawn. That is the real runway test, and it falls after this window.
